messages:
maria_cs: FYI: healthscore backfill ran overnight and triggered duplicate playbook nudges. Ops saw a big queue spike. Anyone on this?

ajay_ops: saw alerts at 06:12 UTC. spike lines up with backfill writes.

taylor_prod: which playbooks re-fired?

maria_cs: renewal-nudge and onboarding-check mostly. backfill origin=legacy-migration batch.

ben_engineer: root cause: backfill updates change updated_at, which our playbook runner treats as a state change. quick fix: add suppression for known backfill origins.

ajay_ops: mitigation idea: playbook.suppression.mode = dry -> canary -> full. also add suppression window hours.

ben_engineer: plan: small PR to add flags: playbook.suppression.mode, playbook.suppression.cascade_window_hours, playbook.suppression.allowed_exemptions. instrument metrics cs.playbook.suppression_candidates and cs.playbook.suppressed_count with labels playbook_name, origin, env.

maria_cs: need exemption for accounts on active renewal outreach. CS will provide a CSV of test cohort (50 accounts) with combinations: legacy_backfill, pending_renewal, recent_manual_contact.

ben_engineer: dry-run SQL for counts:
SELECT origin, COUNT(*) as would_suppress FROM account_health_updates WHERE updated_at BETWEEN '2026-03-22' AND '2026-03-23' AND origin IN ('backfill_job_v2','legacy-migration') GROUP BY origin;

taylor_prod: add a structured log sample so CS/ops can parse: {"ts":"2026-03-23T15:10:01Z","account_id":"12345","playbook":"renewal-nudge","decision":"suppress","reason":"origin=backfill_job_v2"} (as a string in logs).

ajay_ops: ops checklist: run SQL on staging, enable dry-run for 48h, monitor suppression_candidate vs actual fires, canary 10% sharded, then full rollout with 7-day monitor. rollback plan: flip mode back to off and requeue suppressed events for 24h window.

maria_cs: main risk: suppressing critical renewals for mid-market. mitigation: allowlist and per-account override in console. will coordinate comms with sales_ops if needed.

ben_engineer: deploy-bot scheduled a staging deploy for 18:00 UTC in dry-run mode. will post counts here after job finishes.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: feature/healthscore-suppression -> staging at 2026-03-23T18:00:00Z (dry-run).

maria_cs: thanks all. please flag any missed edge cases.
